title: Zuno Agent Policy Addendum (OKF v0.2 Markdown bundle frontmatter)
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter block of agents/<name>/policies/<name>.md (ADR-0513, promoting agents/<name>/policies/ from the ADR-0502 stub to real Stage-2 content). `rag`/`tool`/`policy` are Zuno-invented document kinds with no OKF-core meaning - every field below is [ZUNO EXT]. One file documents exactly one additional constraint this agent imposes on itself, on top of the platform policy floor (policies/tools/tool-policy.yaml, policies/knowledge/knowledge-policy.yaml, policies/quotas/quota-policy.yaml, policies/data-classification/classification.yaml). It can only narrow what the platform policies and this agent's own tasks already allow - it can never grant, widen or override them (same ADR-0011/ADR-0203 'ceiling only narrows' rule every other OKF authorization surface in this repository follows). This document is descriptive only, like ADR-0503's generated Authorization matrix, and must never become an enforcement input on its own: a system that wants to actually enforce a constraint recorded here needs its own policy file and code path, this file only records that the constraint is agreed and why. Consumed today only by platform/supply-chain/validate_okf_bundle.py's cross-reference check; no runtime service reads this file.

okf_version.description: [OKF CORE] OKF envelope version this document conforms to.

type.description: [OKF CORE shape, ZUNO-defined kind] Document kind. Always "policy" for files under agents/<name>/policies/.

title.description: [OKF CORE] Human-readable title, e.g. "Web search fallback scope".

zuno.description: [ZUNO EXT] The additional, narrowing-only constraint this note records.

narrows_platform_policy.description: Self-documenting guardrail: authoring a policy addendum is an explicit acknowledgment that it can only restrict what agent.okf.md/tasks/*.md and the root-level policies/ files already allow, never grant or widen it. Always true - there is no schema-legal way to write a widening addendum.

constraint_type.description: What kind of additional constraint this is.

applies_to.description: What this constraint narrows. `tasks` is required - a policy addendum with no task scope applies to nothing checkable. `tools`/`knowledge` further scope it to specific declarations those tasks already carry (their own `allowed_tools`/`allowed_knowledge`), never to a tool or domain the task doesn't already declare.

tasks.description: Task names (agents/<name>/tasks/<task>.md) this constraint applies to.

tools.description: Optional: restrict this constraint to specific tools among the listed tasks' `allowed_tools`.

knowledge.description: Optional: restrict this constraint to specific knowledge domains among the listed tasks' `allowed_knowledge`.

rationale.description: Why this constraint exists - the business, security or operational reason a maintainer would need to know before relaxing it.

enforcement.description: Whether anything actually enforces this constraint today, or whether it is agreed-but-manual.

mechanism.description: `manual-process`: enforced by human process/review, not code. `external-system`: enforced by a named system outside this repository's OKF-consuming services. `none-yet`: agreed but not enforced anywhere - a documented gap, not a false claim of enforcement.

notes.description: Free-text detail on the mechanism (which process, which system, or what would be needed to close a none-yet gap).
